facts.fact: 尽管满心顾虑，Martin 仍在那天下午叫 Livvie 和 Tamsin 来上舞蹈课，怕 Ledges 的人真以为他把她们关了起来。
facts.anchor: he called us in that afternoon for a dance tutorial

facts.fact: Simon 溜进吸烟室看了一会儿三人练旧式舞步，失望地摇头，说这些都过时了。
facts.anchor: watched us for a moment, and shook his head in dismay

facts.fact: Simon 冲到唱机旁在 Martin 的唱片架上翻找，抽出一张查尔斯顿舞曲唱片如获至宝。
facts.anchor: Simon hurried over and sorted through the disks

facts.fact: Simon 用一个钟头教 Livvie 和 Tamsin 跳查尔斯顿，一遍遍带她们练让人发晕的舞步也不失去耐心。
facts.anchor: For the next hour he taught us, never losing patience

facts.fact: Tamsin 大笑说 Simon 跳得像马戏团的猴子。
facts.anchor: He looks like a bloody circus monkey

facts.fact: 正在背台词的父亲冲下楼发火，头发歪着、马甲敞开、手里攥着剧本，质问他们在干什么。
facts.anchor: came roaring down, hair awry and his waistcoat undone

facts.fact: 连父亲最后也加入了跳舞，笨拙地踩着步子，喊了声 Livvie, to me 并拉起她的手。
facts.anchor: my father stumbling through the steps until even he caught on

facts.fact: 众人一直跳到 Mrs. Fletcher 敲晚饭锣、敲个不停才收场。
facts.anchor: until Mrs. Fletcher started to bang the dinner gong
